name: Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 17, 2021 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Presentation of Black History Month Proclamation
4B.
Presentation on SDG&E Reliability Update by Katie Scanlan, Public Affairs Manager SDG&E
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Oral Communications will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
*If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the January 20, 2021 Special Meeting-Closed Session and January 27, 2021 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2021-02-17 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Consideration of Proposed Changes to the 2021 calendar year City Council Meeting Schedule. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the proposed changes to the 2021 calendar year City Council Meeting Schedule for April meetings and adopt City Council Resolution 2021-12 approving the 2021 meeting schedule changes.
2021-02-17 Item 08B 2021 Council Meeting Schedule Changes
8C.
Introduction of Ordinance 2021-01 establishing a new speed limit on Via Cantebria. Contact Person: Engineering Specialist Barr
Introduce Ordinance 2021-01 (Attachment 1 of the agenda report) titled “An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, Establishing Speed Limit on Via Cantebria” establishing a new speed limit of 30 mph on Via Cantebria between Garden View Road and Town Center Drive.
2021-02-17 Item 08C Via Cantebria Speed Limit Ordinance Intro
8D.
Award of contract to WSP USA Inc. for planning services, in an amount not-to-exceed $593,000; and authorize the City Manager to enter into a Professional Services Agreement for the Circulation Element Update. Contact Person: Principal Planner Gates
Approve the Professional Services Agreement with WSP USA Inc., in an amount not-to-exceed $593,000, and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement, including any amendments and time extensions, in substantial form as included in Attachment 1 of the agenda report, subject to review and final approval by City Attorney.
2021-02-17 Item 08D WSP Contract for Completion of the Circulation Plan Element Update
8E.
Chesterfield Drive Quiet Zone Maintenance Access License and Crossing License Agreements with North County Transit District. Contact Person: Principal Engineer Bankston
1) Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to provide a license agreement to North County Transit District (NCTD) in substantial form as provided in Attachment 1 of the agenda report for maintenance access onto the railroad right of way from San Elijo Avenue; and 2) Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute a Crossing License Agreement with North County Transit District (NCTD) in substantial form as provided in Attachment 2 of the agenda report for the construction of a Roadway Crossing Quite Zone at Chesterfield Drive.
2021-02-17 Item 08E Chesterfield Drive Agreement with NCTD
8F.
Updating City of Encinitas First Tier Speed Cushion Program. Contact Person: Traffic Engineer Bandegan
Approve staff’s recommendation to update the City’s First Tier Speed Cushion Program.
2021-02-17 Item 08F Updating Citywide First Tier Speed Cushion Program
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
10A.
Consider and vote on the proposed artist recommendation for the Encinitas Boulevard undercrossing mosaic. Contact Person: Arts Program Administrator Gilliam
1) Review and vote on the proposed artist recommendation from the Commission for the Arts; and 2) Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute a contract in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1 of the agenda report in the amount of $140,000 and a ten percent (10%) contingency of $14,000 for the project if additional work is needed, for a project total not to exceed $154,000.
2021-02-17 Item 10A Artist Recommendation for the Encinitas Boulevard Undercrossing Mosaic
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS - NONE
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM - NONE
13.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
14.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS
15.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
16.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON FEBRUARY 24, 2021
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
